meta.title: Email Notice for WP Document Revisions demo
meta.description: The released plugin from WordPress.org, with WP Document Revisions, users of each role, Documents in several departments, Document External Lists and notifications already sent. Built from the playground folder by npm run assets-blueprint.
meta.author: NeilWJames

steps.data:
<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: Email Notice demo helpers
 * Description: For the Email Notice for WP Document Revisions playground only: a Departments taxonomy on Documents, and emails recorded as sent without sending them.
 *
 * Copied to wp-content/mu-plugins by playground/demo-content.php.
 *
 * @package Email Notice WP Document Revisions
 */

defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;

/**
 * Departments: a hierarchical taxonomy on Documents, so that Document External Lists can match on it
 * (the Lists use the Document taxonomies, including WP Document Revisions' Workflow States).
 *
 * @return void
 */
function wpdr_en_demo_register_taxonomy() {
	register_taxonomy(
		'department',
		array( 'document' ),
		array(
			'hierarchical'      => true,
			'labels'            => array(
				'name'          => 'Departments',
				'singular_name' => 'Department',
				'menu_name'     => 'Departments',
				'all_items'     => 'All Departments',
				'add_new_item'  => 'Add New Department',
				'edit_item'     => 'Edit Department',
			),
			'show_ui'           => true,
			'show_admin_column' => true,
			'show_in_rest'      => true,
			'rewrite'           => false,
		)
	);
}
add_action( 'init', 'wpdr_en_demo_register_taxonomy', 5 );

/**
 * A playground has no mail server: treat every email as sent, so the logs show what would go out.
 *
 * @param null|bool $short Short-circuit value.
 * @return bool
 */
function wpdr_en_demo_no_mail( $short ) { // phpcs:ignore Generic.CodeAnalysis.UnusedFunctionParameter.Found
	return true;
}
add_filter( 'pre_wp_mail', 'wpdr_en_demo_no_mail' );

// No pause between emails.
add_filter( 'wpdr_en_mail_delay', '__return_zero' );

child tree (array) for each term. * @param int $parent_id Parent term ID. * @return void */ function wpdr_en_demo_terms( $taxonomy, $tree, $parent_id = 0 ) { foreach ( $tree as $name => $children ) { $term = wp_insert_term( $name, $taxonomy, array( 'parent' => $parent_id ) ); if ( is_array( $term ) && ! empty( $children ) ) { wpdr_en_demo_terms( $taxonomy, $children, (int) $term['term_id'] ); } } } /** * Term IDs from names. * * @param string $taxonomy Taxonomy name. * @param string[] $names Term names. * @return int[] */ function wpdr_en_demo_term_ids( $taxonomy, $names ) { $ids = array(); foreach ( $names as $name ) { $term = get_term_by( 'name', $name, $taxonomy ); if ( $term ) { $ids[] = (int) $term->term_id; } } return $ids; } /** * Create a user. * * @param string $login Login (password "password"). * @param string $display_name Display name. * @param string $role Role. * @param int $notify 1 to receive notifications. * @param int $attach 1 to receive the document as an attachment. * @return int User ID. */ function wpdr_en_demo_user( $login, $display_name, $role, $notify = 0, $attach = 0 ) { $user_id = wp_insert_user( array( 'user_login' => $login, 'user_pass' => 'password', 'user_email' => $login . '@example.com', 'display_name' => $display_name, 'first_name' => strtok( $display_name, ' ' ), 'role' => $role, ) ); if ( is_wp_error( $user_id ) ) { return 0; } update_user_meta( $user_id, 'wpdr_en_user_notification', $notify ); update_user_meta( $user_id, 'wpdr_en_user_attachment', $attach ); return (int) $user_id; } /** * Create a Document, optionally with a small text file as its document file. * * @param string $title Title. * @param string $status Post status. * @param int $author Author user ID. * @param string[] $departments Department names. * @param string $state Workflow State name ('' for none). * @param bool $file Whether to add a document file. * @return int Document ID. */ function wpdr_en_demo_document( $title, $status, $author, $departments, $state, $file = true ) { $doc_id = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_type' => 'document', 'post_status' => $status, 'post_title' => $title, 'post_author' => $author, 'post_excerpt' => 'A sample document for the Email Notice demo.', 'post_content' => '', ) ); wp_set_object_terms( $doc_id, wpdr_en_demo_term_ids( 'department', $departments ), 'department' ); if ( '' !== $state ) { wp_set_object_terms( $doc_id, wpdr_en_demo_term_ids( 'workflow_state', array( $state ) ), 'workflow_state' ); } if ( $file ) { $upload = wp_upload_bits( sanitize_file_name( $title ) . '.txt', null, $title . "\n\nA sample document file for the Email Notice for WP Document Revisions demo.\n" ); if ( empty( $upload['error'] ) ) { $attach_id = wp_insert_attachment( array( 'post_mime_type' => 'text/plain', 'post_title' => $title, 'post_status' => 'inherit', ), $upload['file'], $doc_id ); // WP Document Revisions finds the document file from the content (and, in recent versions, this meta). update_post_meta( $doc_id, '_document_attachment_id', $attach_id ); wp_update_post( array( 'ID' => $doc_id, 'post_content' => '', ) ); } } return (int) $doc_id; } /** * Create a Document External List. * * @param string $title Title. * @param string[] $departments Department names to match. * @param array $settings 'tm' (1: all terms must match), 'attach', 'pause', 'log_days', 'notes'. * @param array[] $addresses Each: name, email, pause (0|1). * @return int List ID. */ function wpdr_en_demo_list( $title, $departments, $settings, $addresses ) { $settings = wp_parse_args( $settings, array( 'tm' => 0, 'attach' => 0, 'pause' => 0, 'log_days' => 0, 'notes' => '', ) ); $list_id = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_type' => 'doc_ext_list', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_title' => $title, 'post_excerpt' => $settings['notes'], ) ); wp_set_object_terms( $list_id, wpdr_en_demo_term_ids( 'department', $departments ), 'department' ); update_post_meta( $list_id, 'wpdr_en_tm', (int) $settings['tm'] ); update_post_meta( $list_id, 'wpdr_en_attach', (int) $settings['attach'] ); update_post_meta( $list_id, 'wpdr_en_pause', (int) $settings['pause'] ); update_post_meta( $list_id, 'wpdr_en_log_days', (int) $settings['log_days'] ); $users = array(); foreach ( array_values( $addresses ) as $num => $address ) { $users[] = array( 'rec_num' => $num, 'user_name' => $address[0], 'email' => $address[1], 'pause' => empty( $address[2] ) ? 0 : 1, ); } update_post_meta( $list_id, 'wpdr_en_addressees', wp_json_encode( array( 'rec_num' => count( $users ), 'users' => $users, ) ) ); return (int) $list_id; } /** * Load the demo: helpers, settings, users, terms, Documents, Lists and some notifications sent. * * @param bool $install_mu_plugin Copy the helper mu-plugin into wp-content/mu-plugins (the tests don't). * @return void */ function wpdr_en_demo_load( $install_mu_plugin = true ) { global $wpdr_en; // The Departments taxonomy and the "no mail server" filter, for this request and every later one. if ( ! function_exists( 'wpdr_en_demo_register_taxonomy' ) ) { $source = __DIR__ . '/demo-mu-plugin.php'; if ( $install_mu_plugin && wp_mkdir_p( WPMU_PLUGIN_DIR ) ) { copy( $source, WPMU_PLUGIN_DIR . '/wpdr-en-demo.php' ); } require_once $source; } if ( ! taxonomy_exists( 'department' ) ) { wpdr_en_demo_register_taxonomy(); // The Lists use the Document taxonomies, read when their post type was registered. register_taxonomy_for_object_type( 'department', 'doc_ext_list' ); } // WP Document Revisions checks the activating user's capabilities in the same request that adds them, // before that user's capabilities are reloaded, so it always warns that edit_documents is missing. // The administrator does have it (the next request loads it), so drop the false warning. delete_transient( 'wpdr_activation_issue' ); // Work as the administrator, with the plugin's admin set-up done. wp_set_current_user( 1 ); require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/admin.php'; $wpdr_en->db_version_check(); $wpdr_en->admin_init(); // Settings. update_option( 'blogname', 'Email Notice Playground' ); update_option( 'wpdr_en_set_email_from', 'Document Centre' ); update_option( 'wpdr_en_set_notification_mode', 'Manual' ); update_option( 'wpdr_en_set_notification_about', array( 'Chkbx_Public' => 'Public', 'Chkbx_Password' => 'Password', 'Chkbx_Private' => 'Private', ) ); update_option( 'wpdr_en_set_ext_attach', 1 ); // Remove WordPress's sample post and page, so that the site only holds the demo content. foreach ( array( 'post' => 'hello-world', 'page' => 'sample-page', ) as $post_type => $slug ) { $sample = get_page_by_path( $slug, OBJECT, $post_type ); if ( $sample ) { wp_delete_post( $sample->ID, true ); } } // Users: the administrator receives notifications too. update_user_meta( 1, 'wpdr_en_user_notification', 1 ); $editor = wpdr_en_demo_user( 'editor', 'Elena Editor', 'editor', 1, 0 ); $author = wpdr_en_demo_user( 'author', 'Arthur Author', 'author', 0, 0 ); wpdr_en_demo_user( 'contributor', 'Connie Contributor', 'contributor', 0, 0 ); wpdr_en_demo_user( 'subscriber', 'Sam Subscriber', 'subscriber', 1, 1 ); wpdr_en_demo_user( 'subscriber2', 'Sue Subscriber', 'subscriber', 1, 0 ); // Departments. wpdr_en_demo_terms( 'department', array( 'Finance' => array( 'Payroll' => array(), 'Purchasing' => array(), ), 'Operations' => array(), 'Human Resources' => array(), ) ); // Documents. $budget = wpdr_en_demo_document( '2026 Budget', 'publish', $editor, array( 'Finance' ), 'Final' ); $payroll = wpdr_en_demo_document( 'Payroll calendar', 'publish', $editor, array( 'Payroll' ), 'Final' ); $policy = wpdr_en_demo_document( 'Purchasing policy', 'publish', $editor, array( 'Purchasing', 'Operations' ), 'Final' ); $handbook = wpdr_en_demo_document( 'Staff handbook', 'private', $editor, array( 'Human Resources' ), 'Final' ); wpdr_en_demo_document( 'Fire drill procedure', 'publish', $editor, array( 'Operations' ), 'Final' ); wpdr_en_demo_document( 'Travel expenses form', 'publish', $author, array( 'Finance' ), 'In Progress' ); wpdr_en_demo_document( 'Strategy 2027', 'draft', $editor, array( 'Finance', 'Operations' ), 'Initial Draft', false ); // Document External Lists. wpdr_en_demo_list( 'Auditors', array( 'Finance' ), array( 'attach' => 1, 'log_days' => 90, 'notes' => 'Any Finance document, including Payroll and Purchasing. Log entries kept for 90 days after the document last changed.', ), array( array( 'Alice Audit', 'alice@audit.example' ), array( 'Bob Checker', 'bob@audit.example', 1 ), ) ); wpdr_en_demo_list( 'Board members', array( 'Finance', 'Operations' ), array( 'tm' => 1, 'notes' => 'Only documents in both Finance (or below) and Operations.', ), array( array( 'Carol Chair', 'carol@board.example' ), array( 'Dan Director', 'dan@board.example' ), ) ); wpdr_en_demo_list( 'Suppliers', array( 'Purchasing' ), array( 'notes' => 'Purchasing documents only.' ), array( array( 'Supplies Ltd', 'orders@supplies.example' ), ) ); wpdr_en_demo_list( 'Newsletter', array( 'Operations' ), array( 'pause' => 1, 'notes' => 'Paused: never matched while paused.', ), array( array( 'Club news', 'news@club.example' ), ) ); // Notifications already sent, so that the logs have entries. The budget is sent twice (repeat text). $wpdr_en->notify( $budget, '' ); $wpdr_en->notify( $budget, '
Approved by the board on 1 October.' ); $wpdr_en->ext_notice( $budget, array(), '
Approved by the board on 1 October.' ); $wpdr_en->notify( $payroll, '' ); $wpdr_en->ext_notice( $payroll, array(), '' ); $wpdr_en->ext_notice( $policy, array(), '' ); $wpdr_en->notify( $handbook, '' ); } wpdr_en_demo_load();
